description: Crypto market data: a current USD price snapshot for BTC, ETH and SOL, or one coin via symbol= (bad symbol: 400), for quick market context. JSON per asset: priceUsd, change24hPct, momentum; plus overall momentum, sentiment, direction, avgChange24hPct, asOf. Prices from Coinbase Exchange, CoinGecko fallback (source field). Labels are fixed rules on 24h change, not a forecast and not financial advice. Calls that fail on Base are not charged, except where a route notes otherwise. Price $0.002 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Data changes about every 1 min; calling more often returns the same values. Paid calls are subject to Horizon Pulse buyer terms: https://horizonpulse.dev/terms/buyer

symbol.description: Optional single coin ticker (case-insensitive). Omit for the default BTC, ETH and SOL set. Supported: BTC, ETH, SOL, LINK, QNT, XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, DOT, LTC, BCH, UNI, AAVE, ATOM, NEAR, XLM, SUI, HBAR. An unsupported symbol is refused as an input error and is not charged.
